literal_source_claim: Floer homology is an invariant in symplectic geometry and low-dimensional topology.
provisional_family_shape: After fixing one Floer theory and its analytic and coefficient data, construct a graded chain complex generated by the relevant critical objects, define its differential by counts of source-specified trajectories, prove the differential squares to zero, and prove that the resulting homology is invariant under the source-specified auxiliary choices.
domain_and_universes: Open: depends on selection of a Hamiltonian, Lagrangian, gauge-theoretic, or other Floer theory and its geometric category.
quantifiers: Open: auxiliary data, geometric objects, coefficients, grading, and continuation choices are variant-dependent.
hypotheses: Open: nondegeneracy/transversality, compactness or monotonicity/exactness, orientation, bubbling exclusions, and coefficient hypotheses are variant-dependent.
conclusion: Open: construction, differential-squared-zero, invariance, and comparison claims must be separated and one exact source theorem selected.
excluded_degenerate_cases: None may be excluded at intake; degenerate or non-transverse data, bubbling, empty generator sets, grading conventions, and coefficient characteristic must be decided from the selected theorem.
foundation_profile: Lean 4 dependent type theory; classical choice, quotient, and analytic existence principles not frozen
tcb_profile: Lean kernel, repository toolchain, and pinned mathlib expected; exact imports and dependency closure open
computation_profile: Geometric trajectory counts and noncomputable homological constructions expected; numerical or experimental counts receive no proof credit
freshness_and_revocation_policy: Any change to the selected Floer variant, source edition or locator, geometric hypotheses, coefficients, statement, toolchain, imports, or reviewed crosswalk invalidates dependent evidence and requires revalidation.
status_boundary: Planned intake only. The repository phrase is not a unique proposition; no canonical Lean expression, H0, M0, R0, audit completion, or theorem completion is claimed.
